ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white contiguous regions occupy the distal half of both lobes. The left lobe white region contains sparse dark mottling near the inner boundary. The right lobe white region is more expansive and solid. Dark pigmentation forms a thick, continuous band along the entire trailing edge and central peduncle region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 65-degree internal angle and deep vertical penetration dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency micro-serrations with irregular pixel amplitudes visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated from the water surface line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast clusters of yellowish-brown textured pixels at the distal tips of both lobes, indicating barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation and associated scarring concentrated on the extreme distal tips and outer trailing edges.
